senses.gloss:
शिथिल a. [श्लथ्-किलच् पृषो˚
Uṇ. 1. 53]
1 Loose, loosened, slackened,
relaxed.
--2 Untied, unfastened;
Ś. 2. 6.
--3 Severed, fallen from the
stalk; अर्कस्योपरि शिथिलं च्युतमिव
नवमल्लिकाकुसुमं Ś. 2. 8.
--4 Languid,
enfeebled, unnerved.
--5 Weak,
feeble; अशिथिलपरिरंभ U. 1. 24, 27
'fast or close embrace'.
--6 Flaccid,
flabby.
--7 Dissolved.
--8 Decayed.
--9 Ineffective, futile, vain.
--10
Inattentive, careless; Pt. 4. 116.
--11
Loosely done, not strictly or rigidly
performed.
--12 Cast off, abandoned.
--लं
1 Laxity, looseness.
--2
Slowness. (शिथिलीकृ means {1} to loosen,
unfasten, untie. {2} to relax,
slacken. {3} to weaken, impair, enfeeble.
--4 to give up, abandon; R. 2. 41.
शिथिलीभू {1} to be slackened or
relaxed. {2} to fall off from; Mk. 1. 13).

शिथिलयति Den. P.
1 To
relaxslacken, loosen, Ratn. 1. 14.
--2 To
give up, abandon; शिथिलय क्षणमात्रं
बाष्पमोक्ष Ve. 5.
--3 To lessen, allow
to cool down; न सा इतोगतमनुरागं
शिथिलयति V. 2.

शिथिलायते Den. A. To become
loose or flaccid; Bh. 3. 14.

शिथिलित a.
1 Loosed.
--2 Relaxed,
loosened.
--3 Dissolved.
